prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes. Injury: concussion. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1261; do not mention it.)
text:
Our office represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was traveling in the right lane when the insured vehicle changed lanes without adequate warning and sideswiped the driver's side of our client's car. The impact forced our client's vehicle toward the shoulder and caused the airbag to deploy.

Our client suffered a concussion as a result of the collision. Since the accident, our client has experienced persistent headaches, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating. Treating physicians have restricted our client from work and driving for an extended period, and ongoing care, including neurological follow-up and physical therapy, remains necessary.

The police report documents the lane change as the cause of the collision, and the insured driver acknowledged at the scene that he did not see our client's vehicle. Liability is clear under the applicable traffic statutes.

Accordingly, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all bodily injury claims arising from this loss. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we are prepared to file suit without further notice.
